name: public-discovery-release-hypergraph
scope: One production release path for the bounded Convex public-discovery snapshots and the Cloudflare edge consumer.
invariant: The snapshot-safe Convex producer is deployed and both snapshot families are ready before the frontend consumer is approved; rollback never restores the embedding-heavy request path.

node_types.description: A release condition that must be proven before downstream work starts.
A bounded operator or automation action.
A recovery action that preserves the bounded-read invariant.

edge_types.description: The source must close successfully before the target starts.
The target depends on evidence produced by the source.
A failure at the source activates the target recovery action.
